description: React component for the quiz-taking page, handling quiz display, answer selection, submission, and showing results.

methods.name: QuizTaking()
methods.description: React functional component for taking a quiz, fetching quiz data, handling user answers, and submitting results.

methods.name: load()
methods.description: Asynchronously loads quiz data based on URL parameter, initializing answers state and handling errors.

methods.name: onSelect
methods.description: Updates answers state when a user selects an option for a question.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, sending user's answers to the server and displaying results or errors.
